scene: The dial clicks, parting the mist to reveal three rooftop transit lines.
picture: Flat side-scrolling view of the wet rooftop. On the far left, a glowing glass funicular cabin rests on angled tracks. Next sits the copper tank, beside the player facing right. Centre stands a beetle-like crawler carriage. On the far right, a silver mail train waits at an illuminated gantry beneath a starry sky.
shown: a sloped brass funicular cabin waiting with door open on the far left
a multi-legged mechanised bridge crawler idling near the centre flagstones
a pneumatic mail train carriage humming at the platform on the far right
